//: Curated allowlist for scripts/check-audit.mjs (the CI security-audit job).
Every entry is a HIGH/CRITICAL npm-audit advisory that is upstream-blocked:
the fix requires a major upgrade we have deliberately ruled out (see each
entry's 'unblockedBy'). A high/critical advisory NOT listed here still
fails CI. Prune entries when check-audit.mjs reports them as stale.

allowlist.title: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
allowlist.reason: Dev-toolchain only: image-size is bundled by metro/@expo/cli (Expo SDK 54 / react-native 0.81); it never runs in the deployed API or web app. No patched image-size release exists yet (npm reports the vulnerable range as '*').
allowlist.unblockedBy: expo@57 major upgrade (forbidden: it would undo the Reanimated 3 / Legacy Architecture downgrade) once metro picks up a patched image-size. Re-check whenever Expo SDK is bumped.

allowlist.title: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
allowlist.reason: Same chain as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr: metro -> image-size, build-time only. No patched image-size release exists yet (vulnerable range '*').
allowlist.unblockedBy: expo@57 major upgrade (forbidden for now) once metro picks up a patched image-size. Re-check whenever Expo SDK is bumped.
